overviews.title: What is Naval Architecture?: Course Fees 2026, Subjects, Top Colleges, Admissions

blocks.value: Naval Architecture courses in India, which are also commonly known as Ship Architecture courses, are designed to teach about the mapping, construction, and maintenance of marine vessels and structures. Naval architects look after the overall performance and stability of all types of vessels that float on water, including boats, ships, cruises, and submarines.

There are many Naval Architecture course options after 12th, which are BTech in Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering, and PG courses like MTech or MSc in Naval Architecture . Around 16 Engineering colleges in India provide Naval Architecture courses.

The average fee ranges from INR 40,000 and goes up to INR 10 Lakh. Naval Architecture and Ship Building students can work for fields like Design, Manufacturing, Aerospace, Defense, Maritime Operations, Research, and more. faqs.question: What is Naval Architecture course?
faqs.answer: Naval Architecture is a subfield of Engineering . It is focused on the design, construction, maintenance, and repair of marine vessels and structures. shipyards, maritime enterprises, research organizations, and regulatory authorities use professionals in this subject. Their work is critical for the safe and efficient movement of commodities and people across the world's oceans and rivers. Here are the key points: Field of Study: Blends engineering principles with maritime design to create seaworthy vessels. Course Focus: Designing the form, structure, stability, and overall functionality of ships and other floating structures. Course Options: BTech in Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering (dedicated programme at some universities). BTech in Ocean Engineering with a specialisation in Naval Architecture (more common). Interesting Facts: The growing maritime industry in India demands skilled naval architects. Focus on innovation in areas like fuel efficiency, sustainability, and advanced ship design technologies. Degrees from recognised Indian institutions can open doors for international careers.

faqs.question: What is the duration of Naval Architecture courses in India?
faqs.answer: Naval Architecture courses are mostly available at the diploma, UG, and PG levels in India. If you go for a UG course in Naval Architecture after Class 12 like a BTech in Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering, you need to invest a total of 4 years as the course is split into 8 semesters. For PG Naval Architecture courses, the duration is 2 years . Further, a diploma in the field after completing Class 10 will take up 3 years to complete . There are PG Diploma programs in Naval Construction as well that can be studied after completing graduation and are 1-year long.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for Naval Architecture?
faqs.answer: For Naval Architecture at the UG level. You need to have at least 50 to 60% marks in the Class 12 board exams and clear relevant entrance tests. For PG courses, you must have completed a bachelor's degree in Naval Architecture or a related field with at least 55% marks . For a diploma in Naval Architecture and Offshore Engineering , you must have completed Class 10 with at least 50% marks. You can also opt for a PhD degree for advanced studies, given you hold a master's degree in the field with at least 55% marks . Know more about - Naval Architecture Courses

faqs.question: Is there any age restriction for pursuing Naval Architecture courses in India?
faqs.answer: For studying courses in Naval Architecture, you may come across colleges and universities that have set some sort of age bar for the course. For example, the Indian Maritime University, a well-known institution that offers Naval Architecture courses, has set the upper age limit of 25 years in the case of general category male students, and 27 years for general category female students. If you belong to the reserved category, there is some relaxation given. Also, it is seen that the lower age limit is usually 17 years when students apply for admission to courses in this field. Rest, you can check the guideline given on the websites of the colleges you wish to study the course at to have a clear idea of any such age restrictions for admission. faqs.question: What are the main subjects covered in the BTech Naval Architecture course?
faqs.answer: The syllabus for the BTech Naval Architecture course is different for all the colleges as each of them follow a particular set of guidelines when it comes to their coursework pattern and its outcomes. But, the key topics or concepts covered in the classes are more or less the same. Some of the important subject areas included in the BTech Naval Architecture course are as follows Introduction to Naval Architecture Basic Fundamentals of Physical Oceanography Basic Ship Theory Ship Design and Construction Basic Thermodynamics Electrical Technology AutoCAD

faqs.question: Is the syllabus for Naval Architecture same across all colleges in India?
faqs.answer: The syllabus for Naval Architecture courses is not same rather differs on the basis of the level at which you're pursuing the course, UG, PG, or diploma, and the college offering the program. Despite the coursework pattern being different, the concepts taught in the Naval Architecture classes are almost similar and cover the basics of ship design and construction, oceanography, thermodynamics, ship theory, AutoCAD, knowledge of offshore structures, practical lab work, etc. Know more about - Naval Architecture Courses

faqs.question: Are there any elective subjects in the BTech Naval Architecture syllabus?
faqs.answer: The BTech Naval Architecture course syllabus is a mix of both the core subjects as well as the elective choices. The core subjects are some of the compulsory subjects that you have to study in almost every semester as they are designed in a way to give you as much working knowledge of the maritime industry as possible. Further, you get to choose from a lot of elective subjects according to your interests and learning potential. Some interesting electives included in the BTech Naval Architecture syllabus are Marine Manufacturing Technology, Naval Vessels, Advanced Ship Theory, Dynamics of Offshore structures, Marine Instrumentation and Control, Underwater Acoustics, etc. Know more about - Naval Architecture in India

faqs.question: What is the admission process for Naval Architecture courses at IITs?

blocks.value: To get admission to the IITs for Naval Architecture & Ocean Engineering courses at the UG level, you should have at least 75% marks in Class 12 in the PCM subjects. Also, you should give relevant entrance exams like JEE Main and JEE Advanced and get excellent marks and rank in the same.

Further, you need to complete the college application process in due time. After the exam results are out and you've got your result, make sure to apply for the JoSAA counselling where you will be given a seat for the course. You can then complete the admission formalities by paying the Naval Architecture course fees and confirming your admission.

For PG courses also, the process is similar. The only difference is that you should have a bachelor's degree in Naval Architecture or a relevant field with at least 60% marks and give the GATE exam and participate in the COAP counselling session to be given a seat.
